description: This file implements API key management services, including creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, and validation of API keys, with permission validation based on user roles and features.

methods.name: validatePermissions
methods.description: Validates that requested permissions are allowed for API keys based on user roles, features, and platform constraints.

methods.name: getAllApiKeysByOrganization
methods.description: Retrieves all API keys associated with a specific organization, across all workspaces.

methods.name: getAllApiKeys
methods.description: Retrieves API keys for a workspace, filtered based on user permissions and pagination.

methods.name: getApiKey
methods.description: Fetches a specific API key by its key string.

methods.name: getApiKeyById
methods.description: Fetches a specific API key by its ID.

methods.name: createApiKey
methods.description: Creates a new API key after validating permissions, and returns the list of API keys.

methods.name: updateApiKey
methods.description: Updates an existing API key's name and permissions after validation.

methods.name: deleteApiKey
methods.description: Deletes an API key by ID and workspace ID.

methods.name: verifyApiKey
methods.description: Verifies the validity of an API key.
